# openrouter.ai documentation — Guides — Overview

> 17 page(s) of openrouter.ai documentation — Guides under Overview. Part of the index one level up (../llms.txt).

## Overview

- [BYOK](https://openrouter.ai/docs/guides/overview/auth/byok.md): OpenRouter supports both OpenRouter credits and the option to bring your own provider keys (BYOK).
- [Management API Keys](https://openrouter.ai/docs/guides/overview/auth/management-api-keys.md): To use the key management API, you first need to create a Management API key:
- [OAuth PKCE](https://openrouter.ai/docs/guides/overview/auth/oauth.md): To start the PKCE flow, send your user to OpenRouter's `/auth` URL with a `callback_url` parameter pointing back to your site:
- [MCP](https://openrouter.ai/docs/guides/overview/mcp-server.md): Connect your AI coding tools to OpenRouter over MCP
- [Models](https://openrouter.ai/docs/guides/overview/models.md): The Models API supports query parameters to filter the list of models returned.
- [Audio](https://openrouter.ai/docs/guides/overview/multimodal/audio.md): How to send and receive audio with OpenRouter models
- [Image Generation](https://openrouter.ai/docs/guides/overview/multimodal/image-generation.md): How to generate images with OpenRouter's dedicated Image API
- [Image Inputs](https://openrouter.ai/docs/guides/overview/multimodal/image-understanding.md): Here's how to send an image using a URL:
- [Multimodal Capabilities](https://openrouter.ai/docs/guides/overview/multimodal/overview.md): Send images, PDFs, audio, and video to OpenRouter models, generate speech from text, or transcribe audio to text
- [PDF Inputs](https://openrouter.ai/docs/guides/overview/multimodal/pdfs.md): To configure PDF processing, use the `plugins` parameter in your request. OpenRouter provides several PDF processing engines with different capabilities and pricing:
- [Speech-to-Text](https://openrouter.ai/docs/guides/overview/multimodal/stt.md): How to transcribe audio into text with OpenRouter models
- [Text-to-Speech](https://openrouter.ai/docs/guides/overview/multimodal/tts.md): How to generate speech audio from text with OpenRouter models
- [Video Generation](https://openrouter.ai/docs/guides/overview/multimodal/video-generation.md): How to generate videos with OpenRouter models
- [Video Inputs](https://openrouter.ai/docs/guides/overview/multimodal/videos.md): How to send video files to OpenRouter models
- [Principles](https://openrouter.ai/docs/guides/overview/principles.md): Core principles and values of OpenRouter
- [Report Feedback](https://openrouter.ai/docs/guides/overview/report-feedback.md): Help us improve OpenRouter by reporting issues with AI generations. You can submit feedback directly from the Chatroom or the Logs page.
- [Stripe Projects](https://openrouter.ai/docs/guides/overview/stripe-projects.md): Add OpenRouter to your app with the Stripe Projects CLI
